title: Image reference (CONTRACT.md 8)
description: How a tool names an image to another tool: the file's digest and dimensions, its projection and topology.

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes; the enforced check (2.1).

width.description: Pixels as stored, EXIF orientation not applied.

topology.description: wrap: x = 0 and x = 1 are the same edge.

pixel_sha256.description: The canonical pixel digest (2.2); a convenience, never an error when it differs.
